component.name: Tern
component.summary: Open links in the right browser, profile, or app

description.p: Tern is a link router for KDE Plasma. It becomes your default browser, then sends each click to the right browser profile, web app, or custom handler. It does not touch your default browser until you click the button on the Overview page, and it never takes mailto links or PDFs.

Tern discovers Firefox, Zen, LibreWolf, Floorp, Waterfox, and Chromium family profiles, plus firefoxpwa sites. It remembers destinations by path, not just by host, so github.com/you can go somewhere different from github.com. A short hold bar gives you a chance to stop a link before it opens silently.
